content.comment_body: I've configured my [product_name] for VPN access and can successfully log in remotely. Diagnostics indicate everything is working correctly and a connection to the [product_name] has been established. However, I'm unable to log in to the [product_name] through the VPN using [product_name] [version_no] or via a web browser. Local access through an Ethernet cable works fine. Updating the firmware of the [product_name] enabled the connection to the [product_name], but I still can't access it remotely over VPN. Any suggestions? Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to remotely access the [product_name] via VPN even though the VPN connection and diagnostics are successful, and local Ethernet access works. Firmware updates helped partially, but remote login through VPN remains unresolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to log in to the [product_name] remotely via the VPN, both through [product_name] [version_no] and a web browser, just as easily as with local Ethernet access.
